body.x: MAP Tech(www.maptech.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce smart phone wireless charger ‘m-cloud’.
(Picture: Compact-type wireless power transmitter(left), Tilt-type wireless power transmitter(right))

‘m-cloud’ was composed of Compact type and Tilt-type wireless power transmitter. In case of compact type, you just put it on the charging station for automatic charging. In other case, you can recharge a variety of wireless charger in state of rising or descending by adjusting the tilt.
A Protective Case and Leather Diary Case wireless sets are expected to be introduced.

Since March 2011, MAP Tech, founded in August 2010, has operated wireless charging system and online store(www.m-cloud.kr). In July 2011, it joined World Wireless Charging Standard Association, WPC and has been developed all products to fit Qi specification.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network•Mobile•MP3 as well as Audio•Video•Car Audio•Hardware•Software•Satellite receiver•Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
